menu.menuBg: катък, сумак, карамелизиран лук, хляб с квас
menu.menuEn: katak, sumac, caramelized onion, sourdough bread
menu.pitch: A dip of quince with katak, sumac and caramelised onion, served with our sourdough bread. Sweet, sour and creamy at once.

niche.what: Katak: a thick, tangy Bulgarian spread of fermented sheep’s milk, somewhere between yoghurt and fresh cheese.
Sumac: a dark red spice from dried berries, with a lemony sourness.
Sourdough bread: raised with a natural starter instead of yeast.

menu.facts: A vegetarian option is available: ask the kitchen.

menu.menuBg: домат, чушка, тахан, орех, хляб с квас
menu.menuEn: tomato, pepper, tahini, walnut, sourdough bread
menu.pitch: A roasted pepper and walnut dip with tomato and tahini, served with our sourdough bread.

niche.what: Muhammara: a red pepper and walnut dip from Aleppo in Syria; the name means “reddened”.
Tahini: a paste of ground sesame seeds. Sesame is an allergen.

menu.facts: A vegan option is available: ask the kitchen.

menu.menuBg: хайвер от треска, лимонов сок, хляб с квас
menu.menuEn: cod fish egg mousse, sourdough bread
menu.pitch: A light mousse of cod roe with lemon juice, served with our sourdough bread.

niche.what: Tarama: salted, cured fish roe, here from cod, whipped into a mousse. Known from Greek and Turkish meze.

menu.pitch: A board of cured meats from small producers.
menu.facts: Ask the kitchen which meats are on the board today.

menu.menuBg: български хайвер (30г), блини, див лук, заквасена сметана, яйце
menu.menuEn: bulgarian sturgeon caviar (30g), blini, chives, sour cream, egg
menu.pitch: 30 grams of Bulgarian sturgeon caviar, served the classic way with blini, chives, sour cream and egg.

niche.what: Blini: small, soft buckwheat or wheat pancakes, the classic base for caviar.
Sturgeon: the fish whose roe is true caviar.

menu.menuBg: сезонен плод, орех, костемон, винегрет от бъз и горчица
menu.menuEn: seasonal fruit, walnut, kostemon, elderflower & mustard vinaigrette
menu.pitch: Mixed leaves with seasonal fruit, walnut and kostemon, in an elderflower and mustard vinaigrette.

niche.what: Elderflower: the fragrant white blossom of the elder tree, floral and slightly honeyed.

menu.facts: A vegetarian option is available: ask the kitchen.

menu.menuBg: домат с билки, крокмач, консоме чушки
menu.menuEn: tomatoes with herbs, krokmach, peppers consume
menu.pitch: Roasted pepper with herbed tomatoes and krokmach, finished with a clear pepper consommé.

niche.what: Krokmach: a traditional Bulgarian sheep’s milk product, boiled with salt and left to ferment; thick, salty and tangy.
Consommé: a clear, concentrated broth.

menu.facts: A vegetarian option is available: ask the kitchen.

menu.menuBg: мариновани зеленчуци, сос айрян с хрян, копър
menu.menuEn: pickled vegetables, ayran sauce with horseradish, dill
menu.pitch: Air-dried bonito with pickled vegetables, an ayran sauce with horseradish, and dill.

niche.what: Bonito, a Black Sea fish of the tuna family, salted and dried in the wind: an old way of keeping it on the Bulgarian coast.
Ayran: a cold, salted yoghurt drink, here made into a sauce.

menu.menuBg: бонфиле, гъби, жълтък, понзу, хляб с квас
menu.menuEn: tenderloin, mushrooms, yolk, ponzu, sourdough bread
menu.pitch: Hand-cut raw beef tenderloin with mushrooms, egg yolk and ponzu, served with our sourdough bread.

niche.what: Ponzu: a Japanese sauce of citrus juice and soy sauce. It has soy.

menu.facts: The beef and the yolk are raw: tell guests who are pregnant or ask.

menu.menuBg: свински крачета, сърца, домашни ферментации, горчица, препечен бриош
menu.menuEn: hearts, trotters, lacto veggies, grain mustard, toasted brioche
menu.pitch: Our take on pacha: a cold terrine of pork trotters and hearts, with house-fermented vegetables, grain mustard and toasted brioche.

niche.what: Pacha: a traditional Bulgarian jellied dish of slow-cooked pork, set in its own stock.
Lacto-fermented vegetables: pickled in salt brine, not vinegar, the way sauerkraut is.

menu.menuBg: телешко блек ангъс, скариди, сусамово понзу
menu.menuEn: beef black angus, shrimps, sesame ponzu
menu.pitch: Pan-fried dumplings filled with Black Angus beef and shrimp, with a sesame ponzu.

niche.what: Gyoza: Japanese dumplings, crisp on one side and steamed on the other.
Ponzu (citrus and soy) blended with sesame paste.

menu.facts: They have shellfish (shrimp) as well as beef: say so when you describe them.

menu.menuBg: фалафел, сирене от кашу, крем целина, праз, гъбено жу
menu.menuEn: falafel, cashew cheese, celeriac cream, leeks, mushroom jus
menu.pitch: Black beluga lentils with falafel, a cashew cheese, celeriac cream, leeks and a mushroom jus.

niche.what: Beluga lentils: small, shiny black lentils named after the caviar they look like.
A plant-based cheese made from cashew nuts. Tree nuts are an allergen.
Jus: a concentrated sauce, here made from mushrooms.

menu.facts: A vegan option is available: ask the kitchen.

menu.menuBg: бут конфи, лимец, фоа гра, зелена ябълка, жу
menu.menuEn: leg confit, einkorn, foie gras, green apple, jus
menu.pitch: Confit duck leg with einkorn, foie gras, green apple and jus.

niche.what: Confit: cooked slowly in its own fat until very tender.
Einkorn: one of the oldest wheats, nutty in taste. It has gluten.
Foie gras: the rich liver of a fattened duck.

menu.menuBg: картоф фондан, доматен бьор блан, чорбаджийска чушка, зелен домат
menu.menuEn: potato fondant, tomato beurre blanc, long sweet peppers, green tomatoes
menu.pitch: Rock sea bass with fondant potato, a tomato beurre blanc, long sweet peppers and green tomatoes.

niche.what: A firm, white-fleshed sea fish; on our English menu it is “rock sea bass”.
Beurre blanc: a French butter sauce whisked into a wine and shallot reduction.
Fondant potato: browned in butter, then cooked soft in stock.
A long, pale, sweet Bulgarian pepper.

menu.menuBg: бавно готвено яре, терин от тиква, козе сирене, тиквен сос
menu.menuEn: slowly cooked goatling, pumpkin terrine, goat cheese, pumpkin sauce
menu.pitch: Slow-cooked Boer kid goat with a pumpkin terrine, goat cheese and a pumpkin sauce.

niche.what: Boer: a breed of goat from South Africa raised for its meat. Kid goat is mild and tender, close to lamb.

menu.menuBg: глазирани бейби картофи, холандез левурда, зряло сирене
menu.menuEn: glazed baby potatoes, wild garlic hollandaise, aged cheese
menu.pitch: Beef tenderloin with glazed baby potatoes, a wild garlic hollandaise and aged cheese.

niche.what: Wild garlic: a spring leaf that tastes of mild garlic.
Hollandaise: a warm sauce of egg yolks and butter.

menu.facts: Ask how the guest would like the beef cooked.

menu.pitch: A board of cheeses, served with marmalade.
menu.facts: Ask the kitchen which cheeses are on the board today.

menu.pitch: Our kazandibi: a milk pudding caramelised on the bottom of the pan, scented with mastic and sahlep, with pistachio.

niche.what: Kazandibi: a Turkish milk pudding whose name means “bottom of the pot”; the base is deliberately caught and caramelised. Our Bulgarian name, “загори тенджера”, says the same.
Mastic: the resin of a tree from the Greek island of Chios, with a piney, slightly sweet taste.
Sahlep: a flour from wild orchid tubers that thickens and perfumes milk desserts.

menu.menuBg: мусковадо, замразени и лиофилизирани плодове, бор и хвойна
menu.menuEn: muscovado, frozen and freeze-dried fruits, pine and juniper
menu.pitch: A chocolate dessert sweetened with muscovado, with frozen and freeze-dried fruits, pine and juniper.

niche.what: Muscovado: unrefined cane sugar, dark and sticky, tasting of molasses.
Freeze-dried fruit: dried while frozen, so it stays crisp and keeps its colour and flavour.
Juniper: the berry that gives gin its taste.

wines/midalidare-estate-pas-dose-nv.name: Pas Dosé
wines/midalidare-estate-pas-dose-nv.say: A bone-dry Bulgarian sparkling wine: “pas dosé” means no sugar is added at the end.

wines/edoardo-miroglio-classic-method-br.name: Classic Method Brut
wines/edoardo-miroglio-classic-method-br.say: A Bulgarian sparkling wine made like Champagne, with the second fermentation in the bottle.

wines/tsarev-brod-gergana-reserve-brut-2.name: Gergana Reserve Brut
wines/tsarev-brod-gergana-reserve-brut-2.say: Gergana from Tsarev Brod, Danubian Plain. A Bulgarian white variety: fresh and aromatic, with citrus and white flowers.

wines/sumarroca-cava-reserva-rose-2023.name: Cava Reserva Rosé
wines/sumarroca-cava-reserva-rose-2023.say: A pink Cava from near Barcelona, made by the traditional method: red berries and fine bubbles.

wines/andreola-prosecco-primo-brut-2024.name: Prosecco Primo Brut
wines/andreola-prosecco-primo-brut-2024.say: Glera from Andreola, Valdobbiadene. The Prosecco grape: pear, apple and white flowers, light bubbles.

wines/sieur-darques-cremant-grand-cuvee-.name: Crémant Grand Cuvée Brut
wines/sieur-darques-cremant-grand-cuvee-.say: A French sparkling wine from Limoux, made by the same method as Champagne.

wines/pol-roger-champagne-brut-reserve-n.name: Champagne Brut Réserve
wines/pol-roger-champagne-brut-reserve-n.say: Pol Roger’s classic Champagne: fine bubbles, brioche and green apple.
wines/pol-roger-champagne-brut-reserve-n.story: Light in colour, silky, with red cherry, raspberry and an earthy note.
wines/pol-roger-champagne-brut-reserve-n.facts: Pol Roger was Winston Churchill’s favourite Champagne house.

wines/pol-roger-vintage-rose-champagne-2.name: Vintage Rosé Champagne
wines/pol-roger-vintage-rose-champagne-2.say: A vintage rosé Champagne from a single year, 2018: red berries, depth and fine bubbles.
wines/pol-roger-vintage-rose-champagne-2.story: Light in colour, silky, with red cherry, raspberry and an earthy note.

wines/tsarev-brod-gergana-2024.name: Gergana
wines/tsarev-brod-gergana-2024.say: Gergana from Tsarev Brod, Danubian Plain. A Bulgarian white variety: fresh and aromatic, with citrus and white flowers.

wines/simenta-aligote-2023.name: Aligoté
wines/simenta-aligote-2023.say: Aligoté from Simenta, Danubian Plain. Crisp and lean: green apple, lemon, a light body.

wines/dragoshinov-riesling-2023.name: Riesling
wines/dragoshinov-riesling-2023.say: Riesling from Dragoshinov, Danubian Plain. High acidity, with lime, green apple and a mineral, sometimes petrol-like note.

wines/zhivankin-riesling-2024.name: Riesling
wines/zhivankin-riesling-2024.say: Riesling from Zhivankin, Eastern Thracian Valley. High acidity, with lime, green apple and a mineral, sometimes petrol-like note.

wines/zara-estate-tamyanka-terroir-2024.name: Tamyanka Terroir
wines/zara-estate-tamyanka-terroir-2024.say: Tamyanka from Zara Estate, Thracian Valley. The Bulgarian Muscat: very aromatic, grapey and floral, usually dry.

wines/cenino-sauvignon-blanc-2024.name: Sauvignon Blanc
wines/cenino-sauvignon-blanc-2024.say: Sauvignon Blanc from Cenino, Thracian Valley. Zesty and aromatic: gooseberry, citrus, cut grass.

wines/deuce-mavrud-blanc-2025.name: Mavrud Blanc
wines/deuce-mavrud-blanc-2025.say: A white wine made from the red Mavrud grape: the juice is pressed off the skins before it takes colour.
wines/deuce-mavrud-blanc-2025.story: Bulgaria’s oldest native red grape: dark fruit, spice and firm tannins.

wines/daros-chardonnay-2023.name: Chardonnay
wines/daros-chardonnay-2023.say: Chardonnay from Daros, Struma Valley. From crisp apple and citrus to rich and buttery when aged in oak.

wines/daros-blanc-de-noirs-2024.name: Blanc de Noirs
wines/daros-blanc-de-noirs-2024.say: “Blanc de noirs” means a white wine made from red grapes.

wines/magura-gruner-veltliner-2024.name: Grüner Veltliner
wines/magura-gruner-veltliner-2024.say: Grüner Veltliner from Magura, North-western Bulgaria. Austria’s signature white: citrus, green apple and a white-pepper spice.

wines/bononia-dimyat-2023.name: Dimyat
wines/bononia-dimyat-2023.say: Dimyat from Bononia, North-western Bulgaria. An old Bulgarian white grape: light and fresh, with peach and pear.

wines/bononia-vrachanski-misket-2023.name: Vrachanski Misket
wines/bononia-vrachanski-misket-2023.say: Vrachanski Misket from Bononia, North-western Bulgaria. An aromatic Bulgarian white: muscat-like, floral and fruity.

wines/dragoshinov-winery-estate-chardonn.name: Chardonnay
wines/dragoshinov-winery-estate-chardonn.say: Chardonnay from Dragoshinov Winery Estate, Danubian Plain. From crisp apple and citrus to rich and buttery when aged in oak.

wines/salla-estate-white-blend-2023.name: White Blend
wines/salla-estate-white-blend-2023.say: From Salla Estate, Black Sea region.

wines/clos-bibliotheque-chardonnay-terre.name: Chardonnay Terre Princière
wines/clos-bibliotheque-chardonnay-terre.say: Chardonnay from Clos Bibliothèque, Black Sea region. From crisp apple and citrus to rich and buttery when aged in oak.

wines/clos-bibliotheque-dimyat-terre-pri.name: Dimyat Terre Princière
wines/clos-bibliotheque-dimyat-terre-pri.say: Dimyat from Clos Bibliothèque, Black Sea region. An old Bulgarian white grape: light and fresh, with peach and pear.

wines/argiolas-meri-vermentino-2024.name: Merì Vermentino
wines/argiolas-meri-vermentino-2024.say: Vermentino from Argiolas, Sardinia. Fresh and salty: citrus, green almond, herbs.

wines/schiopetto-pinot-grigio-2023.name: Pinot Grigio
wines/schiopetto-pinot-grigio-2023.say: Pinot Grigio from Schiopetto, Collio DOC. Dry and clean: pear, apple and a light almond finish.

wines/schiopetto-friulano-2023.name: Friulano
wines/schiopetto-friulano-2023.say: Friulano from Schiopetto, Collio DOC. The white of Friuli: pear, herbs and a bitter-almond finish.

wines/gerovassiliou-malagousia-2025.name: Malagousia
wines/gerovassiliou-malagousia-2025.say: Malagousia from Gerovassiliou, Epanomi. A rescued Greek variety: peach, citrus and jasmine, aromatic but dry.
wines/gerovassiliou-malagousia-2025.facts: Vangelis Gerovassiliou is the winemaker who saved Malagousia from extinction.

wines/walter-buchegger-gruner-veltliner-.name: Grüner Veltliner
wines/walter-buchegger-gruner-veltliner-.say: Grüner Veltliner from Walter Buchegger, Krems. Austria’s signature white: citrus, green apple and a white-pepper spice.

wines/martin-mullen-riesling-2021.name: Riesling
wines/martin-mullen-riesling-2021.say: Riesling from Martin Müllen, Mosel Valley. High acidity, with lime, green apple and a mineral, sometimes petrol-like note.

wines/pazo-barrantes-albarino-2019.name: Albariño
wines/pazo-barrantes-albarino-2019.say: Albariño from Pazo Barrantes, Rías Baixas. From the Atlantic coast of Spain: peach, citrus and a salty freshness.

wines/domaine-la-perriere-sancerre-megal.name: Sancerre Mégalithe
wines/domaine-la-perriere-sancerre-megal.say: Sauvignon Blanc from Domaine La Perrière, Loire Valley. Zesty and aromatic: gooseberry, citrus, cut grass.

wines/raoul-gautherin-chablis-2023.name: Chablis
wines/raoul-gautherin-chablis-2023.say: Chablis is Chardonnay from the cool north of Burgundy: lean, mineral, green apple and lemon, usually without oak.
wines/raoul-gautherin-chablis-2023.story: From crisp apple and citrus to rich and buttery when aged in oak.

wines/domaine-dardhuy-montrachet-2021.name: Montrachet
wines/domaine-dardhuy-montrachet-2021.say: A white Burgundy from the Montrachet villages, the most famous Chardonnay vineyards in the world: rich, nutty and long.
wines/domaine-dardhuy-montrachet-2021.story: From crisp apple and citrus to rich and buttery when aged in oak.

wines/albert-bichot-chablis-grand-cru-20.name: Chablis Grand Cru
wines/albert-bichot-chablis-grand-cru-20.say: From the top vineyards of Chablis: more depth and richness than a village Chablis, with the same mineral freshness.
wines/albert-bichot-chablis-grand-cru-20.story: From crisp apple and citrus to rich and buttery when aged in oak.
wines/albert-bichot-chablis-grand-cru-20.facts: Only seven vineyards in Chablis are Grand Cru.

wines/staro-oryahovo-epic-2024.name: Epic
wines/staro-oryahovo-epic-2024.say: From Staro Oryahovo, Black Sea region.

wines/chateau-desclans-grenache-and-roll.name: Grenache and Rolle
wines/chateau-desclans-grenache-and-roll.say: A pale Provence rosé from Château d’Esclans, the estate behind Whispering Angel: delicate, dry and elegant.
wines/chateau-desclans-grenache-and-roll.facts: Rolle is the Provençal name for Vermentino.

wines/bononia-gamza-2024.name: Gamza
wines/bononia-gamza-2024.say: Gamza from Bononia, North-western Bulgaria. A light, fresh red from the Danube, known as Kadarka in Hungary: red berries, soft tannins.

wines/tipchenitsa-merlot-2022.name: Merlot
wines/tipchenitsa-merlot-2022.say: Merlot from Tipchenitsa, North-western Bulgaria. Round and soft: plum, cherry and a touch of chocolate.

wines/edoardo-miroglio-mavrud-reserve-el.name: Mavrud Reserve Elenovo
wines/edoardo-miroglio-mavrud-reserve-el.say: Mavrud from Edoardo Miroglio, Thracian Valley. Bulgaria’s oldest native red grape: dark fruit, spice and firm tannins.

wines/daros-syrah-2023.name: Syrah
wines/daros-syrah-2023.say: Syrah from Daros, Struma Valley. Dark berries, black pepper and a savoury, smoky edge.

wines/villa-melnik-rare-varietas-bush-vi.name: Rare Varietas Bush Vine
wines/villa-melnik-rare-varietas-bush-vi.say: From old bush vines of rare local varieties around Melnik, in the warm south-west.

wines/bratanov-rubin-reserve-2019.name: Rubin Reserve
wines/bratanov-rubin-reserve-2019.say: Rubin from Bratanov, Sakar. A Bulgarian cross of Nebbiolo and Syrah: ripe dark fruit, violet and pepper.

wines/clos-bibliotheque-pinot-noir-2022.name: Pinot Noir
wines/clos-bibliotheque-pinot-noir-2022.say: Pinot Noir from Clos Bibliothèque, Black Sea region. Light in colour, silky, with red cherry, raspberry and an earthy note.

wines/downtown-urban-winery-cabernet-fra.name: Cabernet Franc Reserve
wines/downtown-urban-winery-cabernet-fra.say: Cabernet Franc from Downtown Urban Winery, East Thracian Valley. Medium-bodied, with red fruit, herbs and a fresh, leafy lift.

wines/dragomir-mavrud-komat-2021.name: Mavrud Komat
wines/dragomir-mavrud-komat-2021.say: Mavrud from Dragomir, Thracian Valley. Bulgaria’s oldest native red grape: dark fruit, spice and firm tannins.

wines/dragomir-rubin-komat-2021.name: Rubin Komat
wines/dragomir-rubin-komat-2021.say: Rubin from Dragomir, Thracian Valley. A Bulgarian cross of Nebbiolo and Syrah: ripe dark fruit, violet and pepper.

wines/linar-syrah-2024.name: Syrah
wines/linar-syrah-2024.say: Syrah from Linar, Thracian Valley. Dark berries, black pepper and a savoury, smoky edge.

wines/dragomir-grand-reserve-rubin-2015.name: Grand Reserve Rubin
wines/dragomir-grand-reserve-rubin-2015.say: Rubin from Dragomir, Thracian Valley. A Bulgarian cross of Nebbiolo and Syrah: ripe dark fruit, violet and pepper.

wines/dragomir-grand-reserve-mavrud-limi.name: Grand Reserve Mavrud Limited Edition
wines/dragomir-grand-reserve-mavrud-limi.say: Our own limited edition: a single barrel of Dragomir’s Grand Reserve Mavrud, only 232 bottles, with a label by the artist Pravdoliub Ivanov.
wines/dragomir-grand-reserve-mavrud-limi.story: DOT Sofia, with Dragomir Estate Winery, presents Grand Reserve Mavrud 2021, a limited edition of Bulgaria’s oldest native grape. Just 232 bottles came from a single 225-litre barrel, aged under Dragomir’s private single-barrel programme. The contemporary artist Pravdoliub Ivanov drew the phrase “Love is Liquid” for the label; it comes from his 1998 work “At the Level of the Eyes”.
wines/dragomir-grand-reserve-mavrud-limi.facts:
Only 232 bottles, from one 225 L barrel.
The label reads “Love is Liquid”, drawn by Pravdoliub Ivanov.
Also in magnum (1.5 l) at 210 € and in 3 l at 600 €.

wines/chateau-de-la-chaize-morgon-2023.name: Morgon
wines/chateau-de-la-chaize-morgon-2023.say: Gamay from Château de La Chaize, Beaujolais. Light and juicy: red cherry, strawberry, very little tannin. Good slightly cool.
wines/chateau-de-la-chaize-morgon-2023.facts: Morgon is one of the ten crus of Beaujolais; our list files it under Burgundy.

wines/chateau-penin-la-fleur-grand-cru-2.name: La Fleur Grand Cru
wines/chateau-penin-la-fleur-grand-cru-2.say: A Saint-Émilion Grand Cru from the right bank of Bordeaux, where Merlot leads: plum, soft tannins, a little oak.
wines/chateau-penin-la-fleur-grand-cru-2.story: Round and soft: plum, cherry and a touch of chocolate.

wines/domaine-dardhuy-pinot-noir-2022.name: Pinot Noir
wines/domaine-dardhuy-pinot-noir-2022.say: Pinot Noir from Domaine d’Ardhuy, Burgundy. Light in colour, silky, with red cherry, raspberry and an earthy note.

wines/clos-du-mont-olivet-chateauneuf-du.name: Châteauneuf-du-Pape
wines/clos-du-mont-olivet-chateauneuf-du.say: A mature Châteauneuf-du-Pape from the southern Rhône: Grenache-led, warm and spicy, with dried herbs.
wines/clos-du-mont-olivet-chateauneuf-du.facts: Châteauneuf-du-Pape means “the Pope’s new castle”: the popes lived in nearby Avignon in the 14th century.

wines/produttori-di-manduria-primitivo-e.name: Primitivo Elegia Riserva
wines/produttori-di-manduria-primitivo-e.say: Primitivo from Produttori di Manduria, Puglia. Rich and ripe: jammy dark fruit, sweet spice, full body.
wines/produttori-di-manduria-primitivo-e.facts: Primitivo is the same grape as California’s Zinfandel.

wines/firriato-nero-davola-harmonium-201.name: Nero d’Avola Harmonium
wines/firriato-nero-davola-harmonium-201.say: Nero d’Avola from Firriato, Sicily. Sicily’s great red grape: black cherry, plum and warm spice.

wines/paolo-manzone-nebbiolo-2020.name: Nebbiolo
wines/paolo-manzone-nebbiolo-2020.say: Nebbiolo from Paolo Manzone, Barolo. Pale but powerful: rose, tar and cherry, with high tannin and acidity.

wines/castello-di-volpaia-sangiovese-ris.name: Sangiovese Riserva
wines/castello-di-volpaia-sangiovese-ris.say: Sangiovese from Castello di Volpaia, Tuscany. Sour cherry, herbs and leather, with bright acidity.

wines/marques-de-murrieta-reserva-2018.name: Reserva
wines/marques-de-murrieta-reserva-2018.say: Tempranillo from Marqués de Murrieta, Rioja. Red and dark fruit with vanilla and leather from long oak ageing.
wines/marques-de-murrieta-reserva-2018.facts: Marqués de Murrieta is one of the oldest wineries in Rioja.

wines/tsarev-brod-gergana-ice.name: Gergana Ice
wines/tsarev-brod-gergana-ice.say: A Bulgarian ice wine from the Gergana grape: honeyed and fresh at once.
wines/tsarev-brod-gergana-ice.story: For an ice wine the grapes are picked frozen, so only the sweet, concentrated juice is pressed.

wines/lecru-zibibbo.name: L’Ecrù Zibibbo
wines/lecru-zibibbo.say: Zibibbo from Firriato, Sicily. The Sicilian name for Muscat of Alexandria: apricot, orange blossom, honey.
wines/lecru-zibibbo.story: For a passito the grapes are dried to concentrate their sugar.

wines/px-nectar.name: Néctar Pedro Ximénez
